question_text: Choose the best answer from the alternatives.
stimulus: a. Mother Teresa decided to be a ⎯. (i) nurse (ii) doctor (iii) missionary (iv) physician b. The poverty in ⎯ had a deep impact on her mind. (i) Kolkata (ii) Kuwait (iii) Kualalampur (iv) Kathmandu c. She was born in ⎯. (i) Autumn (ii) Summer (iii) Winter (iv) Spring d. She took her initial vows as a ⎯ on May 24, 1931. stimulus: a. What was the season that led Mother Teresa to be a missionary? b. When did she leave her parental home? c. When was Mother Teresa born? d. What did she teach at St Mary’s High School? e. guide_solution: a. Mother Teresa wanted to be a missionary because she heard a voice within herself that urged her to spread the love of Christ. b. She left her parental home at the age of 18. c.
